audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the final five Haley House records: both versions and all dialogue branches of the group ten-heart confrontation, plus Emily’s gemstone meditation. Every line, player thought, embedded explanation choice, gender branch, relationship meaning, item and city term, group response, and meditation instruction was reviewed in full event context with canonical Rabbit’s Foot, Bouquet, Mayor Lewis, Marnie and Zuzu City terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, dating and prior-event conditions, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the preceding batch, all Haley House records are covered. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
